mergeDialog.title: Merge Music Libraries
mergeDialog.intro: Merge another music library into the current one.
mergeDialog.contents: Playlists, tracks, analysis/fingerprints, SET, Mixtape, and related resources. Recycle Bin is skipped.
mergeDialog.safety: Integrity and disk space are checked first; the source library is not modified. The current library is locked during merge and can recover if interrupted.
mergeDialog.playlist: Both are kept; the source playlist gets a “(from …)” suffix.
mergeDialog.sourceInstruction: Select the music library manifest (.frkbdb) in the source library.
mergeDialog.sourceRequired: Choose a source music library first.
mergeDialog.checkingSource: Checking source structure and disk space…

mergeCuratedDialog.title: Merge Curated Library
mergeCuratedDialog.intro: Import the curated library from another music library into the current one.
mergeCuratedDialog.contents: Only curated folders, playlists, audio, and track analysis/fingerprints. Filter, SET, Mixtape, Recording, Recycle Bin, and curated artists are skipped.
mergeCuratedDialog.safety: Integrity and disk space are checked first; the source library is not modified. The current library is locked during merge and can recover if interrupted.
mergeCuratedDialog.playlist: Same-name folders merge. For same-name playlists, choose keep both or merge into existing in setup.
mergeCuratedDialog.sourceInstruction: Select the music library manifest (.frkbdb) in the source library.
mergeCuratedDialog.sourceRequired: Choose a source music library first.
mergeCuratedDialog.checkingSource: Checking curated structure and disk space…
mergeCuratedDialog.duplicateMergeIntoDescription: Tracks go into the current playlist; colliding files get a suffix.

moveDialog.title: Move Music Library
moveDialog.confirmLead: This moves the current music library to the selected location. The original folder is deleted after it finishes.
moveDialog.crossVolume: The destination is on another disk, so files will be copied first. Keep Track Studio open until it finishes.
moveDialog.sameVolume: The destination is on the same disk. The library folder will be moved directly.
moveDialog.busyBlockingLead: Finish these first, then move the music library:

issues.MERGE_PENDING: Finish or recover the current library merge first.
issues.LIBRARY_BUSY: Wait for the current task to finish before moving the music library.
issues.RELOCATE_ACTIVE: A library move is already running or hasn't finished.
issues.SOURCE_NOT_READY: The current music library is not open or is missing.
issues.PARENT_MISSING: The selected parent folder is missing or inaccessible.
issues.PARENT_NOT_DIRECTORY: Select a folder as the new parent location.
issues.PARENT_IS_LIBRARY: The selected folder is already a music library.
issues.PARENT_INSIDE_LIBRARY: The selected folder is inside a music library. Choose a location outside any library.
issues.DEST_EXISTS: The destination folder already exists. Remove it or choose another location.
issues.NESTED_PATH: The music library cannot be moved into itself.
issues.SAME_PATH: The new location is the same as the current music library.
issues.INSUFFICIENT_SPACE: Not enough free space on the destination disk.
issues.SPACE_UNAVAILABLE: Could not check free space on the destination disk.
issues.COPY_FAILED: Failed to copy the music library.
issues.VERIFY_FAILED: Copy verification failed. The old folder was not deleted.
issues.DELETE_SOURCE_FAILED: The app now uses the new location, but the old folder could not be deleted. Please delete it manually.
issues.JOURNAL_INVALID: There is no unfinished music library move to continue.

movePhase.abortOnly: Cannot continue the music library move
movePhase.cleanup: Cleaning up the incomplete new folder…

moveHint.prompt: The previous move did not finish. Continue resumes the copy; abort removes the incomplete new folder and keeps the old location.
moveHint.abortOnly: The old music library is no longer accessible. Abort will clean up the incomplete new folder, then you can choose a music library again.
moveHint.locked: Do not close Track Studio while moving. If interrupted, the next launch can continue or abort.
moveHint.sourceCleanupFailed: Please delete the old folder manually:

migration.legacyInProgress: Previous upgrade didn't finish. It will run again.
migration.legacyRequired: A legacy music library was detected. Upgrade required to continue.
migration.legacyActions: The upgrade rewrites how music library data is stored. Upgraded libraries can no longer be opened by older Track Studio versions, so don't open this library with them. Large libraries may take a while — don't force quit.
